# ELPD estimation for joint model

Let us denote $\theta = (B, \Sigma, \phi)^\top$ as the collection of model parameters.The joint predictive density of $y^{*}$ (of dimension $u \times q$) given $y$ (of dimension $n \times q$) is

\begin{equation}
\begin{aligned}
\pi(y^{*} \mid y) 
&= \int \int \int 
\pi(y^{*} \mid w^{*}) 
\pi(w^{*} \mid w, \theta) 
\pi(w, \theta \mid y)
\, dw^{*} \, dw \, d\theta \\
&= \int \int \int 
\prod_{i=1}^{u} \prod_{j=1}^{q} 
\pi_{j}\!\left( y_{j}(s_{i}^{*}) \mid w_{j}(s_{i}^{*}) \right)
\pi(w^{*} \mid w, \theta) 
\pi(w, \theta \mid y)
\, dw^{*} \, dw \, d\theta .
\end{aligned}
\end{equation}

The marginal ELPD of $Y^{*}$ given the observed data $Y$ is written as: \begin{equation}
\mathrm{ELPD}
= \log
\bigl[
\pi(y^{*} \mid y)
\bigr]
\end{equation}

The estimated ELPD is therefore given by,

\begin{equation}
\widehat{\mathrm{ELPD}_{joint}}
=
\log
\left[
\frac{1}{T}
\sum_{t=1}^{T}
\prod_{i=1}^{u}
\prod_{j=1}^{q}
\pi_{j}\!\left(
y_{j}(s_i^{*})
\mid
w_{j}^{*(t)}(s_i^{*})
\right)
\right].
\end{equation} where $w_{j}^{*(t)}$ are the $t$-th posterior draw from the \`\`joint" conditional distribution of $W^{*}$ given $(W,B,\Sigma,\phi)$ which is given by \begin{equation}
W^{*} \mid W, B, \Sigma, \phi
\;\sim\;
\mathcal{MN}_{u,q}\!\left(
X^{*} B
-
\big(Q_{\phi,(m)}^{(u,u)}\big)^{-1}
Q_{\phi,(m)}^{(u,n)}
\big(W - X B\big),
\;
\big(Q_{\phi,(m)}^{(u,u)}\big)^{-1},
\;
\Sigma
\right),
\end{equation}

# ELPD estimation for separate model

The predictive density of $y^{*}$ (of dimension $u \times q$) given $y$ (of dimension $n \times q$) for the separate model can be decomposed as \begin{equation}
\pi(y^{*} \mid y) 
= \prod_{j=1}^{q} \pi_{j}\!\left(y_{j}^{*} \mid y_{j}\right)
\end{equation} The marginal ELPD of $Y^{*}$ given the observed data $Y$ is written as: \begin{equation}
\mathrm{ELPD}
= \sum_{j=1}^{q}\log
\bigl[
\pi(y_{j}^{*} \mid y_{j})
\bigr]
\end{equation}

The estimated ELPD for the separate model thus be given as

\begin{equation}
\widehat{\mathrm{ELPD}_{sep}}
=
\sum_{j=1}^{q}
\log
\left[
\frac{1}{T}
\sum_{t=1}^{T}
\prod_{i=1}^{u}
\pi_{j}\!\left(
y_{j}(s_i^{*})
\mid
w_{j}^{*(t)}(s_i^{*}) \right)
\right].
\end{equation} where $w_{j}^{*(t)}$ are the $t$-th posterior draw from the \`\`separate" conditional distribution of $W_{j}^{*},\; j = 1,\ldots,q$ given $(W_j,\beta_j,\Sigma_{jj},\phi_j)$ which is given by \begin{equation}
W_{j}^{*} \mid W_j,\beta_j,\Sigma_{jj},\phi_j
\;\sim\;
\mathcal{MN}_{u,1}\!\left(
X^{*} \beta_j
-
\big(Q_{\phi_{j},(m)}^{(u,u)}\big)^{-1}
Q_{\phi_{j},(m)}^{(u,n)}
\big(W_j - X \beta_j\big),
\;
\big(Q_{\phi_{j},(m)}^{(u,u)}\big)^{-1},
\;
\Sigma_{jj}
\right),
\end{equation}

### Results:

The estimated ELPDs for joint and separate model is -50.645 and -54.886 respectively.
